scene_description: Wooden table with a red journal partly covering a gray book beside a gray power strip. A white charger is plugged into the strip with its cable looped behind the books. Front is the open table edge; left and right are as seen facing it.

targets.name: red journal
targets.description: Red 'Journal of Mathematical Physics, June 2005' lying on the left, partly on top of the gray book.
nearby_obstacles: Gray book underneath its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front and left side are exposed, with open space above.

targets.name: gray book
targets.description: Gray 'Tohoku Mathematical Publications, Number 39' lying partly beneath the red journal, immediately left of the power strip.
nearby_obstacles: Red journal resting on its left portion
Power strip beside its right edge
targets.clearance_notes: Left portion is covered by the journal; the exposed right edge is close to the power strip.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the red journal off the gray book and set it on the open table.

targets.name: power strip
targets.description: Gray power strip with black sockets and an orange switch lying to the right of the books, with a white charger plugged into its left end.
nearby_obstacles: White charger plugged into its left socket
Gray book beside its left end
targets.clearance_notes: Front and right side are exposed; the charger occupies the left socket.
targets.other_notes: Power cord extends from the right end; its far end is not visible.

targets.name: white charger
targets.description: White Belkin charger standing in the left socket of the power strip, with a light-colored cable connected at the top.
targets.clearance_notes: Body is exposed above the strip, with open space around its sides.

candidate_improvements.description: Unplug the charger and set it on the table approximately 15 cm in front of the power strip.

targets.other_notes: Plugged into the power strip; cable remains attached.
